captureIssues.description: Some real 200% physical viewport PNGs visibly retain the native blinking input caret. unverified: Actual active-content scrolling or measurable scroll-range movement at 200%; the toolbar/draft frames show substantially the same viewport.

320px/768px, touch, RTL, English locale, brand override, forced colors and reduced motion outside this diagnostic subset.
Firefox/WebKit and the current/new Table/TablePro/Tree gap candidate; this historical Chromium run does not validate them.
Consecutive stable regression runs and approval of first baselines.
